title: Dan Sheehan discredited through stigma

tellings.quote: there was an attempt to discredit him through stigma because of his interest in the iran contra matter right with the christic institute and so i think he was fed wrong information probably so that he'd swing at a bad pitch

plain: In the late 1980s, the lawyer Dan Sheehan, who was working on the Iran-Contra affair with a legal group called the Christic Institute, became the target of an effort to discredit him through stigma, according to the mathematician Eric Weinstein. Weinstein, telling Michels what he takes from Sheehan's own account, thinks Sheehan was "probably" fed false information "so that he'd swing at a bad pitch". If so, it would show a way of ruining someone's credibility by baiting them into making wild claims.
